name: What are accessibility modifications, and can they be done as general home repairs?

mainEntity.name: What are accessibility modifications, and can they be done as general home repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessibility modifications are specialized home repairs designed to remove barriers and improve daily mobility for residents with disabilities, injuries, or age-related limitations. These repairs include widening interior doorways, installing ADA-compliant grab bars, building wheelchair ramps, lowering countertops, and converting high-step bathtubs into zero-barrier walk-in showers. Unlike standard aesthetic repairs, accessibility work requires careful structural framing, secure backing behind drywall to support heavy loads, and slip-resistant tile flooring. HH Remodeling LLC provides dedicated disability and accessibility modifications, ensuring all structural reinforcements blend naturally with your home’s existing interior design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessibility modifications include widening doorways, installing grab bars, and building roll-in showers, requiring reinforced framing behind drywall for safety.
